lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # ruff-29024: Preserve cycle markers in ParamSpec specialization

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: PR #29024. The frozen issue file holds ruff PR #4615 about printer flags. It is not the ty issue 4615 named in the PR body. Three bot comments report no change in conformance, memory, and ecosystem results. No human review comments exist.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Why: present, from the PR. The PR says recursive specialization must keep its cycle marker so inference can normalize it. Without the marker the type keeps growing until cycle inference panics. Do not take the motive from the frozen issue file. That file is unrelated.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Size: small.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Parts: one story. Groups: 1.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. ParamSpec cycle fix with corpus tests: `crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/infer/builder/subscript.rs`, `crates/ty_python_semantic/resources/corpus/ty_4615_recursive_paramspec_legacy.py`, `crates/ty_python_semantic/resources/corpus/ty_4615_recursive_paramspec_pep695.py`. The two corpus files test the same fix with legacy and PEP 695 syntax. They belong with the logic.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - the fix keeps Divergent cycle markers in ParamSpec calls instead of mapping them to unknown parameters. Unknown still falls back to unknown parameters.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - the two new corpus files test recursive ParamSpec specialization with legacy and PEP 695 syntax for the generic specialization reproducer in ty issue 4615.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The PR says the lambda and collection reproducers are covered by #29025 and #28986. This PR covers only the generic specialization reproducer.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The existing fallback for Unknown is unchanged.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Bot comments report no change in conformance, memory, or ecosystem results.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not split the logic from the corpus files into one group per file.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not cite the frozen ruff PR #4615 as the motive or as ty issue 4615.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not make document lookFor from the bot comments. No source differs from the diff, so document lookFor stays empty.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not restate the test plan as lookFor. Name only what a reader would miss.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
